# goslop text fixture — niquests unicode_/redirect pure-call smoke (no assert;
# intentional "does not raise on encoding/redirect").
lang: python
file: tests/test_requests.py
---
import niquests


def test_unicode_get(httpbin, url, params):
    niquests.get(httpbin(url), params=params)


def test_unicode_header_name(httpbin):
    niquests.put(
        httpbin("put"),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"},
        data="\xff",
    )


def test_pyopenssl_redirect(httpbin_secure, httpbin_ca_bundle):
    niquests.get(httpbin_secure("status", "301"), verify=httpbin_ca_bundle)


def test_redirect_with_wrong_gzipped_header(httpbin):
    s = niquests.Session()
    url = httpbin("redirect/1")
    s.get(url)
